title: 第4章 修为提升至金丹
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
陈默看着系统的面板，只见上面显示着几行文字。

    【作为同门弟子本应该同心连枝，想不到宿主竟然如此丧心病狂，竟然抢夺师姐的灵石实在是人神共愤】

    【恭喜宿主获得任务奖励：修为提升至金丹一层】

    陈默能明显的感觉到，系统奖励发放的瞬间他体内的真元大大增强了不少。

    如今他的修为已然达到了金丹一层的实力。

    不过这系统是真抽象，明明是自己的灵石被抢了自己只不过是拿回来属于自己的东西而已。

    结果系统却说是自己抢了人家的。

    好家伙。

    “算了也无所谓了，反正能获得奖励提升修为就行。”

    陈默在心中说道。

    走在旁边的周玄一脸崇拜和震惊的看着他。

    “陈默你的修为什么时候这么强了？你刚刚的实力怎么说也有筑基期吧？”

    周玄在旁边惊讶的道。

    陈默摆了摆手并没有说什么。

    但是周玄这时候却说。

    “陈默……陆瑶师姐毕竟是林风瑶的师妹而且还是陆云的亲妹妹，咱们刚刚打了陆瑶恐怕这事她不会善罢甘休的，我估计用不了多久咱们就会遭到压力和报复。”

    “我看接下来咱们两个的日子不会好过了。”

    周玄在心中担心道。

    不过他这人也很仗义也并没有因为陈默刚刚动手打了陆瑶，因为担心遭到陆云和林风瑶的报复。

    从而和陈默划清界线。

    反而有些担心并且看着陈默说道。

    “陈默你放心吧，回头他们要追究起来就说是我，这件事跟你没关系。”

    陈默看着周玄他拍了拍周玄的肩膀说道，“放心吧不碍事的。”

    ……

    在刚才那片空地上陆瑶十分狼狈地从地上爬了起来，脸上表情铁青无比眼神中也闪过厌恨。

    “陈默这个废物到底用了什么卑鄙的手段？我竟然不是他的对手。”

    “这怎么可能？”

    “陈默被林凤瑶师姐当做炉鼎，他的身体一日不如一日，真元也早就被师姐吸收干净怎么可能是我对手？”

    陆瑶心中说道。

    这时有几个女弟子走了过来，看到从地上爬起来一脸狼狈相的陆瑶。

    那几个师姐妹们都很好奇的问道。
content_en:
Chen Mo looked at the system panel and saw a few lines of text displayed on it.

    [As fellow disciples, we should be united as one, but we didn’t expect the host to be so heartless and crazy, and to snatch the spiritual stone from the senior sister, which is really outrageous for both humans and gods]

    [Congratulations to the host for receiving the mission reward: the cultivation level has been upgraded to the first level of Jindan]

    Chen Mo could clearly feel that the moment the system rewards were distributed, the real energy in his body was greatly enhanced.

    Now his cultivation has reached the level of Golden Core.

    But this system is really abstract. It was obvious that his spiritual stone was robbed and he was just getting back something that belonged to him.

    As a result, the system said that he had robbed someone else's property.

    Good guy.

    "Forget it, it doesn't matter, as long as you can get rewards and improve your cultivation."

    Chen Mo said in his heart.

    Zhou Xuan, who was walking next to him, looked at him with admiration and shock.

    "Chen Mo, when did your cultivation become so strong? Your strength just now also has a foundation building period, right?"

    Zhou Xuan said in surprise from the side.

    Chen Mo waved his hand and said nothing.

    But Zhou Xuan said at this time.

    "Chen Mo...Senior sister Lu Yao is Lin Fengyao's junior sister after all, and she is also Lu Yun's biological sister. We just beat Lu Yao, I'm afraid she won't let it go. I guess it won't be long before we will be pressured and retaliated against."

    "I don't think things will be easy for the two of us in the future."

    Zhou Xuan was worried in his heart.

    However, he was also very righteous and did not beat Lu Yao just because Chen Mo was afraid of retaliation from Lu Yun and Lin Fengyao.

    Thus, he drew a clear line with Chen Mo.

    Instead, he was a little worried and looked at Chen Mo and said.

    "Chen Mo, don't worry. If they want to investigate later, they'll just say it's me. This matter has nothing to do with you."

    Chen Mo looked at Zhou Xuan, patted Zhou Xuan's shoulder and said, "Don't worry, it's okay."

    …

    In the clearing just now, Lu Yao got up from the ground in a very embarrassed manner, with an extremely livid expression on his face and hatred flashing in his eyes.

    "What despicable methods did Chen Mo, this loser, use? I am no match for him."

    "How is this possible?"

    "Chen Mo is used as a furnace by Senior Sister Lin Fengyao. His body is getting worse day by day. His true energy has been absorbed by Senior Sister long ago. How can he be my opponent?"

    Lu Yao said in her heart.

    At this time, several female disciples came over and saw Lu Yao getting up from the ground with a embarrassed look on her face.

    The senior sisters asked curiously.
title_en: Chapter 4: Cultivation upgraded to golden elixir
